inventoryItem.title: Inventory Item
inventoryItem.description: Food inventory item prepared and tracked in the canteen

itemName.description: Name of the prepared food dish

category.description: Food category e.g. Main Course, Salad, Bakery, Soup

mealShift.description: Shift: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, or Late Night

soldQty.description: Quantity sold or served to students

preparedAt.description: ISO timestamp when item was prepared

safeHoldingExpiry.description: ISO timestamp for safe holding temperature expiry

status.description: Status: active, review_pending, repurposed, donated, composted

urgency.description: Urgency tier: Low, Medium, High, Critical

smellVisualPassed.description: Whether staff verified smell and visual inspection

safetyNotes.description: Staff inspection notes or temperature logged

reviewedByStaff.description: Name or ID of reviewing staff member

decision.description: Staff decision: pending, approved_for_donation, repurpose_in_kitchen, discount_flash_sale, compost_discard

donationManifest.title: Donation Manifest
donationManifest.description: Verified donation manifest for surplus food redistribution

recipientOrg.description: Partner charity, food bank, or campus pantry

contactPerson.description: Name and phone of pickup contact

itemsSummary.description: Summary of food items included in donation

tempAtHandoffC.description: Measured temperature at handoff in Celsius

/inventory/{itemId}.description: Canteen food inventory batches with prepared and sold figures

/surplusReviews/{reviewId}.description: Staff review log for surplus risk assessment and safety approval

/donationManifests/{manifestId}.description: Traceable donation handoff receipts for food rescue partners
